It is a subsidiary shrine ({{ill|Setsumatsusha|ja|末社|qid=Q135009906|lt=Massha}}) of {{ill|Atsuta Shrine|abstract|Q482065|ar|أتسوتا جينغو|az|Atsuta məbədi|cs|Svatyně Acuta|de|Atsuta-jingū|eu|Atsuta santutegia|fa|معبد آتسوتا|fr|Atsuta-jingū|hu|Acutai nagyszentély|id|Kuil Atsuta|it|Santuario di Atsuta|ja|熱田神宮|ko|아쓰타 신궁|la|Atsuta Templum|or|ଆତ୍ସୁତା ଶାଳ|pl|Atsuta-jingū|pt|Santuário de Atsuta|simple|Atsuta Shrine|th|ศาลเจ้าอัตสึตะ|tr|Atsuta Tapınağı|uk|Святилище Ацута|zh|熱田神宮|qid=Q482065|lt=Atsuta Shrine}}, with its enshrined deity being {{ill|Ame-no-Uzume|ja|天鈿女命}}. Locally, it is colloquially known as "Suzu no Miya" (鈴の宮). In the past, a river known as {{ill|Shinhori river|fr|Shinhori-kawa|ja|新堀川 (名古屋市)|qid=Q3482210|lt=Shōjin River}} flowed near the shrine, and travelers along the {{ill|Tōkaidō (region)|ca|Tōkaidō|ckb|تۆکایدۆ|es|Tōkaidō (región)|fa|توکایدو|id|Tōkaidō|it|Tōkaidō (regione)|ja|東海道|ko|도카이도|lt|Tokaido (sritis)|min|Tokaido|pl|Tōkaidō (region)|pt|Tōkaidō (região)|ru|Токайдо|simple|Tōkaidō (region)|sr|Токаидо (регион)|tr|Tōkaidō|uk|Східноморський край|zh|東海道|zh_min_nan|Tôkaidô|zh_yue|東海道|qid=Q1196306|lt=Tōkaidō}} were required to receive a bell purification ritual at this shrine to cleanse themselves before visiting Atsuta.

After the war, it was relocated ({{ill|Sengū|de|Sengū|ja|遷宮|qid=Q2271023}}) to its current site facing the former Tōkaidō.

From the subway station {{ill|Atsuta Jingu Temma-cho Station|eo|Stacio Temma-chō|fr|Atsuta Jingu Temma-cho (métro de Nagoya)|id|Stasiun Temma-chō|it|Temma-chō (metropolitana di Nagoya)|ja|熱田神宮伝馬町駅|jv|Setatsiyun Temma-chō|ko|아쓰타진구텐마초역|ur|ات سوٹا جنگو تیما-چو اسٹیشن|zh|熱田神宮傳馬町車站|qid=Q970033|lt=Atsuta Shrine Denmachō Station}}, if you proceed about 50 m to the southwest, you will reach the former {{ill|Tōkaidō (region)|ca|Tōkaidō|ckb|تۆکایدۆ|es|Tōkaidō (región)|fa|توکایدو|id|Tōkaidō|it|Tōkaidō (regione)|ja|東海道|ko|도카이도|lt|Tokaido (sritis)|min|Tokaido|pl|Tōkaidō (region)|pt|Tōkaidō (região)|ru|Токайдо|simple|Tōkaidō (region)|sr|Токаидо (регион)|tr|Tōkaidō|uk|Східноморський край|zh|東海道|zh_min_nan|Tôkaidô|zh_yue|東海道|qid=Q1196306|lt=Tōkaidō}} road. Continuing approximately 100 m toward the southeast, the shrine grounds will appear on your right. The grounds are only a few meters wide and are hard to spot from the national road.
